arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/test_invalid.py <<'PYEOF'
"""Invalid-input acceptance tests."""
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import Checks, base, prof, query, rec, ERR

c = Checks()
BAD = c.expect_invalid

P = {'id': 'p', 'max_aliases': 4, 'cname': 'follow', 'wildcard': 'rfc'}
def D(**kw):
    d = {'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}
    d.update(kw)
    return d

# ---------- top level / JSON syntax ----------
BAD('empty stdin', b'')
BAD('garbage', b'not json')
BAD('root array', b'[]')
BAD('root scalar', b'5')
BAD('root string', b'"hello"')
BAD('root null', b'null')
BAD('missing all keys', b'{}')
BAD('missing zones', b'{"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('missing observations', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[]}')
BAD('extra key', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[],"x":1}')
BAD('duplicate root key',
    b'{"zones":[],"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('dup key nested',
    b'{"zones":[{"origin":".","records":[{"owner":".","type":"A","data":"1.2.3.4","data":"5.6.7.8"}]}],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('profiles string', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":"x","queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('zones dict', b'{"zones":{},"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('trailing data', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]} {}')
BAD('trailing comma',
    b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[],}')
BAD('single quotes', b"{'zones':[],'profiles':[],'queries':[],'observations':[]}")
BAD('multi-row', b'{"zones":[],\n"profiles":[], "queries":[], "observations":[]}')
BAD('bad utf8', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[{"id":"q","name":"\xff\xfe.","type":"A","cost":1}],"observations":[]}')
BAD('nan', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":NaN,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('infinity', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":Infinity,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('-infinity', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":-Infinity,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('overflow float 1e999', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":1e999,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('float cost', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[{"id":"q","name":"a.","type":"A","cost":1e2}],"observations":[]}')
BAD('float cost 1.0', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[{"id":"q","name":"a.","type":"A","cost":1.0}],"observations":[]}')
BAD('huge int cost', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[{"id":"q","name":"a.","type":"A","cost":' + b'9'*5000 + b'}],"observations":[]}')
BAD('bool cost', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[{"id":"q","name":"a.","type":"A","cost":true}],"observations":[]}')
BAD('bool max_aliases', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":true,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('null cost', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[{"id":"q","name":"a.","type":"A","cost":null}],"observations":[]}')
BAD('nested depth 33',
    b'{"zones":' + b'[' * 31 + b']' * 31 + b',"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('nested depth 5000', b'{"zones":' + b'[' * 5000 + b']' * 5000 + b',"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')
BAD('unclosed bracket', b'{"zones":[[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')

# ---------- names ----------
for label, name in [
    ('relative name', 'a.test'),
    ('empty name', ''),
    ('double label dot', 'a..test.'),
    ('leading dot', '.a.test.'),
    ('space in label', 'a b.test.'),
    ('non-ascii label', '\u00e4.test.'),
    ('escaped dot', 'a\\.b.test.'),
    ('label too long', 'x' * 64 + '.'),
    ('star mixed in label', 'a*.test.'),
    ('underscore ok not', None),
    ('wire too long', '.'.join('x' * 40 for _ in range(6)) + '.' + 'x' * 30 + '.'),
    ('trailing empty label', 'a.test..'),
]:
    if name is None:
        continue
    BAD('query name: ' + label,
        json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P],
                    'queries': [{'id': 'q', 'name': name, 'type': 'A', 'cost': 1}],
                    'observations': []}).encode())
    BAD('zone origin: ' + label,
        json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': name, 'records': []}], 'profiles': [P],
                    'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
    BAD('cname data: ' + label,
        json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': [
            {'id': 'o', 'query': 'q', 'profile': 'p',
             'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                        'answer': [{'owner': 'a.', 'type': 'CNAME', 'data': name}]}}]}).encode())
BAD('zone name int', b'{"zones":[{"origin":5,"records":[]}],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')

# ---------- zone structure ----------
BAD('zone extra key', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [], 'x': 1}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('zone missing records', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.'}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('zone records dict', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': {}}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('zero zones ok', None) if False else None
BAD('17 zones', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'z%d.' % i, 'records': []} for i in range(17)], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('conflicting zones', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': []}, {'origin': 'TEST.', 'records': []}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('conflicting zones root', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': []}, {'origin': '.', 'records': []}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('owner outside zone', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'a.test.', 'records': [rec('b.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('owner suffix not label', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('xtest.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('root owner under non-root zone', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('cname at origin', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('test.', 'CNAME', 'a.test.')]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('cname at root origin', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [rec('.', 'CNAME', 'a.')]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('cname plus other type', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.test.'), rec('a.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('cname plus txt wildcard owner', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.test.'), rec('A.test.', 'TXT', 'x')]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('two cname targets', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.test.'), rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'c.test.')]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('65 distinct rrset', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.%d' % i) for i in range(65)]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('1025 total records', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a%d.test.' % (i % 16), 'A', '192.0.2.%d' % (i % 256)) for i in range(1025)]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('shadowed data still validated', json.dumps({
    'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('b.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]},
              {'origin': 'sub.test.', 'records': [rec('b.sub.test.', 'CNAME', 'c.'), rec('b.sub.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]}],
    'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('record extra field', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [{'owner': 'a.', 'type': 'A', 'data': '1.2.3.4', 'ttl': 5}]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('record missing field', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [{'owner': 'a.', 'type': 'A'}]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('record wrong type case', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [rec('a.', 'a', '1.2.3.4')]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('record type cname lower', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [rec('a.', 'cname', 'b.')]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())

# ---------- record data ----------
for label, data in [
    ('leading zero octet', '01.2.3.4'),
    ('octet 256', '256.0.0.1'),
    ('three octets', '1.2.3'),
    ('five octets', '1.2.3.4.5'),
    ('empty octet', '1..3.4'),
    ('negative octet', '-1.2.3.4'),
    ('hex octet', '0x1.2.3.4'),
    ('plus octet', '+1.2.3.4'),
    ('spaces', '1.2.3.4 '),
    ('non-string', 12345),
]:
    BAD('A data: ' + label, json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [rec('a.', 'A', data)]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
for label, data in [
    ('scope id', 'fe80::1%eth0'),
    ('ipv4 only', '1.2.3.4'),
    ('bad hex', '::gg'),
    ('triple colon', '1::2::3'),
    ('with prefix', '2001:db8::/32'),
    ('brackets', '[::1]'),
    ('leading space', ' ::1'),
    ('trailing space', '::1 '),
    ('too many groups', '1:2:3:4:5:6:7:8:9'),
    ('non-string', 32),
]:
    BAD('AAAA data: ' + label, json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [rec('a.', 'AAAA', data)]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
for label, data in [
    ('too long', 'x' * 257),
    ('tab char', 'a\tb'),
    ('newline', 'a\nb'),
    ('unit separator', 'a\x1fb'),
    ('del char', 'a\x7fb'),
    ('non-ascii', '\u00e4'),
]:
    BAD('TXT data: ' + label, json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [rec('a.', 'TXT', data)]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('TXT non-string', json.dumps({'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [rec('a.', 'TXT', 7)]}], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())

# ---------- profiles ----------
BAD('no profiles', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('nine profiles', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [prof('p%d' % i) for i in range(9)], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('dup profile ids', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [prof('p'), prof('p', ma=1)], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('profile extra key', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [{'id': 'p', 'max_aliases': 1, 'cname': 'follow', 'wildcard': 'rfc', 'x': 1}], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('profile missing key', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [{'id': 'p', 'max_aliases': 1, 'cname': 'follow'}], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
for pid in ['', 'a b', 'a.b', 'a' * 33, '\u00e4', 'q/1', 5]:
    BAD('profile id %r' % (pid,), json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [{'id': pid, 'max_aliases': 1, 'cname': 'follow', 'wildcard': 'rfc'}], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
for ma in [-1, 65, '3', 3.0]:
    BAD('max_aliases %r' % (ma,), json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [{'id': 'p', 'max_aliases': ma, 'cname': 'follow', 'wildcard': 'rfc'}], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
for cname in ['', 'Follow', 'stopx', 1, None]:
    BAD('cname %r' % (cname,), json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [{'id': 'p', 'max_aliases': 1, 'cname': cname, 'wildcard': 'rfc'}], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())
for wc in ['', 'RFC', 'offx', 'one_label', 1]:
    BAD('wildcard %r' % (wc,), json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [{'id': 'p', 'max_aliases': 1, 'cname': 'follow', 'wildcard': wc}], 'queries': [], 'observations': []}).encode())

# ---------- queries ----------
BAD('21 queries', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [query('q%d' % i, 'a.') for i in range(21)], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('dup query ids', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [query('q', 'a.'), query('q', 'b.')], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('query extra key', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [{'id': 'q', 'name': 'a.', 'type': 'A', 'cost': 1, 'x': 1}], 'observations': []}).encode())
BAD('query missing cost', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [{'id': 'q', 'name': 'a.', 'type': 'A'}], 'observations': []}).encode())
for cost in [0, 1001, -5, '3', 3.5, True]:
    BAD('cost %r' % (cost,), json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [{'id': 'q', 'name': 'a.', 'type': 'A', 'cost': cost}], 'observations': []}).encode())
for rtype in ['a', 'cname', 'MX', '', None, 'CNAME ']:
    BAD('query type %r' % (rtype,), json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [{'id': 'q', 'name': 'a.', 'type': rtype, 'cost': 1}], 'observations': []}).encode())

# ---------- observations ----------
Obs = lambda oid, qr='q', pr='p', **res: {'id': oid, 'query': qr, 'profile': pr, 'result': res}
def doc_with_obs(obs, profiles=None, queries=None):
    return {'zones': [], 'profiles': profiles or [P],
            'queries': queries or [query('q', 'a.')], 'observations': obs}

BAD('65 observations', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [query('q', 'a.')], 'observations': [
    {'id': 'o%d' % i, 'query': 'q', 'profile': 'p', 'result': {'status': 'timeout'}} for i in range(65)]}).encode())
BAD('dup observation ids', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o'), Obs('o', result={'status': 'timeout'})])).encode())
BAD('obs no such query', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', qr='nope', status='timeout')])).encode())
BAD('obs no such profile', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', pr='nope', status='timeout')])).encode())
BAD('obs int refs', json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [query('q', 'a.')], 'observations': [{'id': 'o', 'query': 1, 'profile': 'p', 'result': {'status': 'timeout'}}]}).encode())
BAD('obs extra key', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([{'id': 'o', 'query': 'q', 'profile': 'p', 'result': {'status': 'timeout'}, 'x': 1}])).encode())
BAD('obs missing result', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([{'id': 'o', 'query': 'q', 'profile': 'p'}])).encode())
BAD('status unknown', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='timeoutx')])).encode())
BAD('status response no rcode', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', answer=[])])).encode())
BAD('status timeout extra keys', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='timeout', rcode='NOERROR', answer=[])])).encode())
BAD('status response missing answer', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', rcode='NOERROR')])).encode())
BAD('rcode bad', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', rcode='NOERROR2', answer=[])])).encode())
BAD('rcode lowercase', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', rcode='noerror', answer=[])])).encode())
BAD('rcode int', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', rcode=0, answer=[])])).encode())
BAD('answer dict', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', rcode='NOERROR', answer={})])).encode())
BAD('answer 129 records', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', rcode='NOERROR', answer=[rec('a.', 'A', '192.0.2.%d' % i) for i in range(129)])])).encode())
BAD('obs record bad owner', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', rcode='NOERROR', answer=[rec('nope', 'A', '192.0.2.1')])])).encode())
BAD('obs record bad data', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', rcode='NOERROR', answer=[rec('a.', 'A', '1.2.3')])])).encode())
BAD('obs record dup allowed not invalid', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', rcode='NOERROR',
    answer=[rec('a.', 'A', '192.0.2.1'), rec('a.', 'A', '192.0.2.1'), rec('a.', 'CNAME', 'b.')])]))) if False else None
BAD('obs record cname and A coexist ok', json.dumps(doc_with_obs([Obs('o', status='response', rcode='NOERROR',
    answer=[rec('a.', 'A', '192.0.2.1'), rec('a.', 'CNAME', 'b.')])])))

# oversized input (just over the 8MiB cap)
big = b'{"zones":[],"profiles":' + json.dumps([P]).encode() + b',"queries":[],"observations":' + b' ' * (8 * 1024 * 1024) + b'[]}'
BAD('oversized 8MiB+1', big)
# candidates inside a deeply nested *answer* ... (string contents do not count)
BAD('deep nesting in answer',
    json.dumps({'zones': [], 'profiles': [P], 'queries': [query('q', 'a.')], 'observations': [
        Obs('o', status='response', rcode='NOERROR', answer=[rec('a.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')] * 128)]}).replace(
        '"answer": [', '"answer": ' + '[' * 40 + ' ' + ']' * 40 + ' ' + '[', 1).encode())

sys.exit(c.done('invalid-input tests'))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tests/test_invalid.py
